name: Anthropology (PMn)

rules.name: Completion Requirements
rules.desc:
The requirements for the PhD Minor in Anthropology include the following:
Complete 20 units of ANTHRO subject code courses at the 300 level with an overall minimum letter grade of ‘B’, or higher.

• Students will select an area focus in one of three areas.

• One theoretical ANTHRO graduate course at the 300-level, from chosen focus

• Three Elective Courses (Each elective course is 5 units and must be taken for a letter grade)
For additional information regarding the PhD minor in Anthropology, consult the department webpage.

children.name: Archaeology Focus
children.desc: Completing one of these courses fulfills the Required Theory Course

children.name: Culture and Society Focus
children.desc: Completing one of these courses fulfills the Required Theory Course

children.name: Self-Designed Focus in Anthropology
children.notes:
If choosing a self-designed focus in Anthropology, the PhD Minor Plan of Study must be approved by Minor Advisor.

• One theoretical ANTHRO graduate course at the 300-level

• Three Elective Courses

rules.name: Overall minimum grade of B on the minor courses

gpa: Overall minimum letter grade of ‘B’, or higher
grading: Theory courses must receive minimum grade of 'B+'
policies: Directed Individual Study units are not approved for the PhD minor in Anthropology.
transferPolicy: All of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: You pick one area focus: Archaeology or Culture and Society, whose theory course needs a B+ or better, or a self-designed focus whose theory course you move in once the minor advisor approves your plan of study. The audit also checks three 5-unit electives from the list, letter grades on every course, and the 20 units. You check the overall B by hand, since the text does not say whether it is per course or an average.
